dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned ring structures with high-contrast, jagged perimeters. Gradient transition is sharpest at the outer boundaries of the prominent mid-dorsal closed loops where light pixels meet the dark background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, localized light-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the lower-lateral edge and interspersed between larger macro-annuli along the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a large scalene triangle; a secondary, tighter cluster of four small circular centroids forms an irregular quadrilateral near the upper posterior region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of approximately five parallel, dark, linear marks are visible on the lower-right lateral flank, exhibiting the appearance of repetitive physical trauma or rake-like scars.
